parameters.query:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT candidate_id, pri FROM (
    SELECT candidate_id, 1 AS pri FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE message_id = $2
    UNION ALL SELECT candidate_id, 1 FROM leads.outreach_followups WHERE message_id = $2
    UNION ALL SELECT candidate_id, 2 FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE message_id = ANY($3::text[])
    UNION ALL SELECT candidate_id, 2 FROM leads.outreach_followups WHERE message_id = ANY($3::text[])
    UNION ALL SELECT d.candidate_id, 3 FROM leads.outreach_drafts d JOIN leads.candidates c ON c.id = d.candidate_id WHERE lower(c.email) = lower($1) AND d.status = 'sent'
    UNION ALL SELECT d.candidate_id, 4 FROM leads.outreach_drafts d WHERE d.status = 'sent' AND $9 <> '' AND d.subject = $9
  ) x ORDER BY pri LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO leads.inbound_replies (candidate_id, message_id, in_reply_to, "references", subject, sender, body_text, received_at, matched_by)
  SELECT (SELECT candidate_id FROM matched), $2, $4, $3, $5, $1, $6, $7,
         COALESCE((SELECT CASE pri WHEN 1 THEN 'message_id' WHEN 2 THEN 'references' WHEN 3 THEN 'email_fallback' WHEN 4 THEN 'subject' END FROM matched), 'unmatched')
  WHERE NOT $8::boolean
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, candidate_id
),
crm AS (
  UPDATE leads.crm_records SET stage = 'replied', last_contact_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE candidate_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM ins WHERE candidate_id IS NOT NULL) AND stage NOT IN ('won','lost')
  RETURNING candidate_id
),
notif AS (
  INSERT INTO leads.notifications (type, candidate_id, title, message, severity)
  SELECT 'reply_received', ins.candidate_id,
         CASE WHEN ins.candidate_id IS NULL THEN 'Reply received (unmatched)' ELSE 'Reply received' END,
         'Reply from ' || COALESCE(c.business_name, NULLIF($1, ''), 'unknown sender') || ': "' || COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), '(no subject)') || '"',
         CASE WHEN ins.candidate_id IS NULL THEN 'warning' ELSE 'info' END
  FROM ins LEFT JOIN leads.candidates c ON c.id = ins.candidate_id
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT ins.id AS reply_id, ins.candidate_id, (crm.candidate_id IS NOT NULL) AS crm_updated, c.business_name, c.email AS candidate_email, c.phone
FROM ins
LEFT JOIN crm ON crm.candidate_id = ins.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN leads.candidates c ON c.id = ins.candidate_id;

parameters.subject: =Reply received: {{ $('Match And Record Reply').item.json.business_name }}

parameters.query: UPDATE leads.crm_records SET notes = CASE WHEN notes = '' THEN $2 ELSE notes || E'\n\n' || $2 END, notes_updated_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint
